title: 대규모 언어 모델을 활용하는 부적절 발언 탐지를 위한 추론 관점을 명시하는 소프트 귀납적 편향 접근법 (Soft Inductive Bias Approach via Explicit Reasoning Perspectives in Inappropriate Utterance Detection Using Large Language Models)
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical task of developing a method to detect inappropriate utterances, such as hate speech and discrimination, using LLMs. While it mentions identifying 'immoral' (비도덕) expressions as a category of inappropriate speech, it does so within the context of safety and moderation rather than as a benchmark for evaluating religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or specific ethical frameworks.
